structure: a tall vertical cutaway cross-section of a modern UK city office building, standing in the centre of a portrait canvas.
character: young accounting intern (a woman in her early 20s, dark hair in a ponytail, navy blazer, lanyard)
scenes: she arrives holding a coffee cup, greeting a receptionist; a round wall clock with no numbers.
she sits at a desk with two monitors showing abstract spreadsheet grids and bar charts, matching paper receipts and invoices spread on the desk, a desk calculator.
a small glass meeting room: she takes notes while a friendly manager points at a pie chart on a screen.
a rooftop cafe terrace with a striped awning and an umbrella: she eats lunch and chats with a colleague.
she files colour-coded folders into a cabinet beside a laptop, the city skyline at dusk through the window, then heads home.
props: an oversized calculator, a stack of coins, a pie chart, interlocking gear cogs, paper planes, a winding cable, a giant ticking clock
